reviews.snippet:
Every time I go here, I pay a lot of money and wait a long time for them to get my order wrong. The shakes are pretty good, but something is wrong with their take-out system.

I ordered a large avocado bacon burger with no tomato today. Three times I was handed an order, twice the cook called them back and said no no that’s not hers. The third time the manager stepped in and packed the order for me. I was there long enough to get extra sauce and everything. All I ordered was a burger and I paid over $8 for them to get it wrong. Disappointing all around.

reviews.snippet: I've had Smasburger and this place was off. After a really long wait, I expected the burger to be top notch, but it wasn't. The people in front of me were also waiting a while even after I got there. It wasn't particularly too busy even though I did go around lunch time. The staff were friendly. The soda machine was out of ice, and there was water on the floor around the machine. Don't expect this to be a quick grab and go type of place. Expect to spend at least 20-30 mins waiting for your order.

reviews.snippet: I am so psyched that Smashburger came to this campus!  I had tried the restaurant once before in a distant NJ location and was pleased to see all the menu options.  The shakes are fantabulous. I ran into a mob scene my first time, around 1pm, and service was still exceptional for a fast food restaurant.  Next time, I'll go at 11am for lunch.  I hope they make online ordering available soon.
